security.title: Security
security.sessionsHint: Manage your login sessions. Revoking a session will force it to sign out.
security.revokeSessionConfirm: This will force the session to sign out. Continue?

userSettings.title: User Settings
userSettings.webdavHint: One account & password for both: WebDAV mounts your files, CalDAV syncs your calendars (DAVx5, Apple Calendar, Outlook, etc.).
userSettings.webdavPasswordHint: Paste this App Password into your WebDAV client along with the account above.
userSettings.noAppPasswords: No App Passwords yet — create one in the App Passwords section first.
userSettings.passwordUnavailable: Can't be re-displayed — create a new one
userSettings.caldavHint: CalDAV server: take the Mount URL above and replace its trailing /dav/files/ with /dav. Same account & password — no separate calendar token needed.
userSettings.icalHint: Subscribe to your personal calendar in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook, etc. (private events + team-shared events + dated todos). Pick an App Password below and the URL gets a token automatically — no account needed.
userSettings.icalPickPassword: Choose the App Password for this subscription:
userSettings.icalNoPassword: Select an App Password above to generate the subscription URL.
userSettings.icalHintUrl: The token is the selected App Password (read-only). Anyone with this link can read your calendar — only add it to calendar services you trust; revoking the App Password disables the subscription.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.deleteConfirm: The event will be moved to the trash and can be restored anytime. Delete?
calendar.inviteHint: Invited members see this event in their own personal calendar (a copy sharing the same UID).

todos.title: Todos
todos.deleteConfirm: The todo will be moved to the trash and can be restored anytime. Delete?
todos.shareHint: Shared lists appear on the member's todos page and both sides can add and check items. Unticked lists stay private to you.
todos.deleteListConfirm: Deleting the list also deletes every todo in it. Continue?
todos.inviteHint: Invited members get a copy in their own todo list (same UID VTODO). Their local completion state is never overwritten by sync.

notes.title: Notes
notes.deleteListConfirm: Deleting the list also deletes every note in it. Continue?
notes.shareHint: Shared lists appear on the member's notes page and both sides can edit. Unticked lists stay private to you.
notes.deleteConfirm: The note will be moved to the trash and can be restored anytime. Delete?
notes.empty: No notes in this list yet
notes.noList: Pick a list on the left to start
notes.inviteHint: Invited members get a copy in their own personal notes (same UID VJOURNAL). Local edits never overwrite each other.

trash.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete this file? This cannot be undone.
trash.itemsPurgeConfirm: Permanently delete this item? This cannot be undone.

team.title: Team settings
team.inviteHint: Share this link with people to join; valid for 7 days
team.resetTokenHint: Used for the team calendar iCal subscription (team.ics?token=…, read-only) and the read-only team WebDAV/CalDAV account (team:team_id + this token).
team.joinHint: Generate an invite link in team settings, join and auto switch
team.webdavHint: Mount team files via WebDAV for shared access on large screens or network drives.
team.webdavNote: Use team:team_id as the account and the calendar token as the password (read-only, shared/public content only). WebDAV mounts at the URL above; the CalDAV server is /dav under the same origin and lists only the team calendar (no personal calendars).

settings.title: Settings
settings.corsHint: Allow these origins to access calendar subscriptions & WebDAV from the browser. Separate with commas, or use * to allow all
settings.appPasswordsHint: Create App Passwords so external clients (CalDAV, WebDAV, iCal) can sign in as you. You can copy them from this list at any time.
settings.appPasswordCreated: App password created. You can copy it again anytime from the list below.
settings.revokeAppPasswordConfirm: This app password will be permanently deleted. Continue?
settings.sessionsHint: Manage your login sessions. Revoking a session will force it to sign out.
settings.revokeSessionConfirm: This will force the session to sign out. Continue?
settings.trashHint: Deleted files and attachments go to the trash and are permanently removed after the configured number of days.
settings.trashZeroHint: Set to 0 to keep items forever (no automatic deletion).
settings.trashItemsHint: Deleted calendar events, todos, and notes go to the trash and are permanently removed after the configured number of days (configured independently of the file trash).

error.weak_password: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain both letters and numbers
error.invite_invalid: Invite link is invalid or expired
error.todo_list_not_found: List not found or not accessible
error.edit_own_only: You can only edit your own items
error.delete_own_only: You can only delete your own items
